clause: Auto-layout advanced: absolute-position exclusion, stroke-in-spacing, deep nesting, convert-to-auto-layout [STU-DS-044,STU-DS-045]

scope.summary: Implement advanced auto-layout: excluding individual children from the flow (ignore-auto-layout / absolute position) while keeping them inside the frame under constraint-based positioning (MT-362) for overlays such as badges; an advanced setting choosing whether child stroke weights count in spacing; arbitrarily deep nesting of auto-layout frames combining per-level direction/gap/padding/resizing; and a convert-to-auto-layout command (optionally assisted) restructuring a plain frame's contents into an equivalent auto-layout structure as ordinary local StudioDocument state.
acceptance_criteria: absolute-position exclusion + stroke-in-spacing + deep nesting + convert-to-auto-layout; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: convert-to-auto-layout command + advanced controls reachable via author_id
test: absolute-position child excluded from flow but framed; stroke-in-spacing toggle; deep nesting; convert restructures a plain frame

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Advanced auto layout

risk_if_missed: No absolute children, nesting, or convert; complete responsive trees impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
